summary: Frontend-only breadcrumb and regression QA completed against the public URL. Breadcrumb trails, link/plain/current semantics, Home navigation, homepage/admin exclusions, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, responsive geometry at all requested viewports, service hero media regressions, route rendering, and production build all passed. One accessibility/readability defect remains on light hero pages: the translucent pill and muted breadcrumb text do not meet WCAG AA contrast.

design_issues.screen: Breadcrumbs on light hero pages (verified on /industries; also applies to other white heroes such as /case-studies)
issues: At 12px/500 weight, the current white crumb over bg-black/50 composited on white measures 3.95:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1; the Home link at text-white/60 measures 2.46:1. Increase pill opacity and non-current text opacity/color.

action_items: Improve light-hero breadcrumb contrast, for example by using a substantially darker pill (such as bg-black/75) and brighter Home/intermediate text; recheck every 12px crumb at >=4.5:1.
critical_code_review_comments: Breadcrumbs.jsx applies bg-black/50 globally, text-white/60 to links and text-white/45 to plain intermediate crumbs. Because the pill is translucent, its effective background on a white hero is #808080, causing both current and muted crumbs to fail normal-text contrast.

success_rate.frontend: 97% of requested checks passed; all functional/integration/responsive/regression checks passed, with one light-hero contrast failure

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified exact trails on SAP, Resources, Industries, About, HRMS and Case Studies. SAP schema names were Home/SAP Consulting because the visual plain-text Services segment has no real index URL; Resources schema included Home/Insights/Resources. Positions and https://infocure.in item URLs passed. Home crumb click and exclusions on / and /adminia passed. SAP and Resources passed 1920x800, 820x1180 and 390x844 with no breadcrumb/H1/CTA overlap or horizontal overflow. Four flagship services retained correct decoded static images and no hero video; Homepage and Digital Transformation retained videos. No console/page errors occurred across the requested route sweep. CI production build compiled successfully. Only unresolved defect is light-hero breadcrumb contrast.
rca_of_the_issue: Breadcrumbs.jsx uses one translucent bg-black/50 pill for every backdrop. On a white hero, alpha compositing produces an effective #808080 background. Opaque white current text then reaches only 3.95:1, while text-white/60 Home links composite to about #CCCCCC and reach only 2.46:1. The same styling is acceptable over dark heroes but is not backdrop-independent as intended.
